# Conseil & Ned Land

- [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) — Comrade of — [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) — fellow prisoners held on board the Nautilus · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P18](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P19](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P5](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0005), +1 more</sub>
- [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) — Friend of — [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) — cabin mates and friends on board the Nautilus · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P0](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P16](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0016), +3 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> On board the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln), the crew and Captain [Farragut](../character/commander-farragut.md) eagerly search for the sea monster, joined by the expert Canadian harpooner [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md). While sitting together on the poop deck, [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) debates the monster's existence with [Ned](../character/ned-land.md), using scientific calculations of deep-sea pressure to persuade the skeptical harpooner.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IV NED LAND

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P6](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P12](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P13](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P24](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0024)_

> [The Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) sails around [Cape Horn](../codex/places.md#cape-horn) and searches the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) Ocean for months without finding the creature, causing the crew's excitement to turn into frustration. [Commander Farragut](../character/commander-farragut.md) agrees to turn back if the monster is not sighted within three days. On the final evening of the deadline, [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) spots the target in the darkness.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P18](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P33](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0033)_

> After falling into the sea, the narrator is rescued by [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and together they keep afloat until they discover [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) standing on a hard structure. They realize the presumed sea monster is actually a metallic submarine vessel, onto which they climb before being pulled inside by masked men at dawn.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P6](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P47](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0047), [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P58](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0058), [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P67](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0067)_

> [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) are locked in a dark room inside the mysterious submarine vessel. Electric light is switched on, and two unidentified men enter, but they cannot communicate because the prisoners speak French, English, German, and Latin to no avail. After the strangers leave, a steward brings them clothes and a meal before the three men fall asleep.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P1](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P14](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P30](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P46](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0046)_

> [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) awakens in the cell feeling oxygen-deprived until fresh sea air is pumped in as the vessel surfaces to breathe. [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) awaken shortly after, and as hours pass without food, [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) loses his temper. When the steward finally opens the door, [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) attacks and throttles him until a voice speaks in French.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P3](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P6](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P20](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P24](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0024)_

> Captain Nemo reveals his identity and informs [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) that they will remain prisoners on the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) forever, granted freedom only within the ship. After [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) are dismissed to their cabin, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) invites [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) to breakfast on marine dishes and explains his deep love for the sea. Afterwards, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) begins showing [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) around the vessel, starting with its extensive library.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P40](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P58](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0058), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P71](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0071)_

> Captain Nemo shows [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) the various instruments and inner workings of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), explaining how electricity powers the vessel, its speed, and its auxiliary boat. They walk through the ship's compartments toward the engine room before returning to the saloon for further technical details.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY P0](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY P6](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY P16](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XI ALL BY ELECTRICITY P31](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0031)_

> Captain Nemo takes the surface bearings before submerged navigation begins and [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) examines the route on a chart. [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) and [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) join [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) in the saloon just as the wall panels slide back, revealing an illuminated underwater window into the ocean life outside. They spend hours watching the sea creatures before the observation windows close again for the night.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P4](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P18](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P28](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P35](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0035)_

> After days of Captain Nemo's absence, Professor [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) receives a note inviting him and his companions on a hunting expedition in the submarine forests of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo) Island. Over breakfast, Captain Nemo explains the technology—including modified diving apparatus, electric lanterns, and special air-guns—that will allow them to walk and hunt underwater.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P16](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P19](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P34](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P46](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0046)_

> [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and Captain Nemo don diving suits and equipped air guns in the Nautilus's wardrobe while [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) declines to join. After entering an airlock, the group exits the submarine to walk along the ocean floor, admiring the undersea landscapes and flora as they head toward the submarine forests of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV A WALK ON THE BOTTOM OF THE SEA

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV A WALK ON THE BOTTOM OF THE SEA P6](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XV A WALK ON THE BOTTOM OF THE SEA P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV A WALK ON THE BOTTOM OF THE SEA P20](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XV A WALK ON THE BOTTOM OF THE SEA P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031)_

> On the platform of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), Captain Nemo converses with [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) about the life and depths of the ocean. The submarine continues its journey across the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific), passing Hawaii and the [Marquesas](../codex/places.md#marquesas), until [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) observe a tragically sunken shipwreck through the drawing-room panels.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XVII FOUR THOUSAND LEAGUES UNDER THE PACIFIC P28](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0028)_

> As the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) arrives near the island of [Vanikoro](../codex/places.md#vanikoro), Captain Nemo asks Professor [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) about the fate of La Pérouse's expedition. [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) recounts the historical searches, after which [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) reveals that he discovered the final wreck of the third vessel constructed by the survivors, showing recovered papers belonging to La Pérouse.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P46](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII VANIKORO P49](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0049)_

> As the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) navigates the treacherous [Torres Straits](../codex/places.md#torres-straits), it runs aground near the Island of [Gilboa](../codex/places.md#gilboa). Captain Nemo remains confident that the upcoming full moon tide will free the ship. Taking advantage of the situation, [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) obtain permission to take a small boat to the island to hunt for fresh meat.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P16](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P26](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P41](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0041)_

> [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) go ashore on the island of [Gilboa](../codex/places.md#gilboa) to harvest wild plant foods like breadfruit and coconuts. The following day, they return to hunt game, successfully acquiring pigeons, a bird of paradise, a wild hog, and several kangaroos. As they enjoy an elaborate dinner on the beach, their discussion of escaping the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) is interrupted by a falling stone.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P20](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P39](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P70](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P78](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0078)_

> Fleeing an attack by [Papuan](../codex/places.md#papua) islanders, [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) retreat to the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Captain Nemo remains unconcerned by the surrounding natives, spending time discussing explorer [Dumont](../character/urville.md) d'Urville with [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) while assuring him the submarine will refloat safely at high tide. As the promised moment approaches, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) orders the hatches opened despite the swarm of natives outside.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P8](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P22](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P70](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P87](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0087)_

> As high tide approaches, Captain Nemo opens the hatches, defying the [Papuans](../codex/factions.md#papuans) waiting outside. The natives, along with [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md), are repelled by an electrified railing charged by Nemo's power source. Protected by the electric barrier, the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus) safely floats free from the coral reef at the exact predicted moment.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P98](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0098), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P99](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0099), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P103](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0103), [v1 CHAPTER XXI CAPTAIN NEMO’S THUNDERBOLT P105](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0105)_

> While observing the horizon, Captain Nemo spots something alarming and abruptly orders [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) to be locked away in their cell. Soon after eating a provided meal, [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) realizes the food was drugged with a soporific, causing all three men to fall into a heavy sleep.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA”

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA” P21](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA” P24](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA” P28](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXII “ÆGRI SOMNIA” P43](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0043)_

> Captain Nemo calls upon [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md) to examine a fatally injured crew member who dies shortly after. The following morning, [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) leads [Aronnax](../character/aronnax.md), [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) on an underwater excursion to bury the deceased sailor in a coral cemetery.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII THE CORAL KINGDOM
